source.title: Learning the value of information in an uncertain world

confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily replicated demonstration that the weight placed on an accumulated estimate is set by inferred environmental volatility, with a neural correlate (ACC) that predicts the per-subject learning rate. Source quality is very high. Confidence is held below 0.8 because the domain is reward, not harm, and because the paper establishes a volatility-dependent LEARNING RATE rather than a precision term read out by a downstream consumer -- ARC-052's structural commitment (a precision scalar emitted alongside the latent, consumed by E3) is one inferential step beyond what was measured.
failure_signatures: The volatility-to-learning-rate relation was estimated at the level of a scalar value estimate; it does not establish that a high-dimensional latent (z_harm_a) admits a single well-behaved precision scalar rather than needing a per-dimension one.

Subjects tracked volatility near-optimally only after substantial task exposure; a volatility estimator wired into z_harm_a precision inherits a warm-up period during which its own estimate is unreliable, and nothing in this paper says what a system should do with the accumulator meanwhile.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Human subjects assess the volatility of an environment in an approximately Bayes-optimal manner and adjust how strongly each new outcome updates their estimate accordingly; activity in anterior cingulate cortex during outcome observation reflects the salience of that outcome for predicting the future, and variation in the ACC signal predicts variation in subjects' learning rates.
mapping.ree_translation: ARC-052 clause (2) -- z_harm_a precision increases with accumulation stability, and high volatility reduces confidence in the accumulated threat state. Behrens et al. give the biological form of exactly this dependency, in its dual: under high volatility the accumulated history is down-weighted relative to the current observation. A precision scalar on z_harm_a that falls with estimated volatility is the same quantity expressed on the consumer side rather than the update side, and the ACC result supplies a candidate substrate for where the volatility estimate itself would live.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The paper is about appetitive/reward value in a two-armed bandit, not about a harm or threat stream, and it manipulates volatility of an outcome PROBABILITY, not the stability of an accumulated homeostatic deviation. Learning rate and precision are formally related but not identical: a learning rate governs how the estimate is updated, whereas ARC-052 asks for a precision that governs how much a DOWNSTREAM consumer (E3) trusts the estimate. A system could implement volatility-sensitive learning without ever exposing a precision signal, which is the specific architectural commitment ARC-052 makes.
mapping.source_context: Healthy adult humans, fMRI, probabilistic two-armed bandit with stable and volatile blocks.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality reflects venue, replication history, and the fact that this is the paper the whole volatility-learning-rate literature is built on. Mapping fidelity is the limiting term: reward domain, and update-side rather than consumer-side precision.
